added_test_coverage: HTTP maintenance clear followed by ask: empty snapshot returns the fixed no-documents answer without retrieval, generation, or reservation.

HTTP restore creates a new revision; ask stays 503 without a ready current-revision index and reserves no generation; a separate worker configured with the matching baseline reconciles with zero document encoding; current retrieval contains only the new revision.

When the API restore source differs from the configured baseline, the worker encodes changed content rather than reusing stale baseline vectors; retrieval and mocked answer contain current content only.

An in-flight RAG request retains its captured old retrieved context while a concurrent document publish and worker reconciliation index a newer revision; later retrieval returns only the newer revision.
Mock-provider HTTP requests at concurrency 1, 2, and 4 all complete, with measured provider overlap matching each concurrency level.
existing_coverage_reused: Public-demo in-flight cap rejects excess asks without waiting.
Cancellation holds the slot until the synchronous worker finishes.
Readiness checks do not retrieve or reserve; retrieval failure and missing readiness do not reserve generation.
Reset preflight, model-free baseline mapping, source-preserving recovery, and worker restart behavior.
